### Key Observations
- **Blob 1** is the largest (~799 voxels), centered near voxel **(51, 17, 40)**.
- **Blob 0** is mid-sized (~461 voxels), centered near voxel **(8, 45, 36)**.
- **Blob 2** is the smallest (~365 voxels), centered near voxel **(27, 14, 45)**.
- All three blobs are well-separated in space with no overlapping bounding boxes, confirming they are truly disconnected objects.
